Where in the world?

A country browser with name search, region filters and individual country pages.

  • HTML
  • CSS
  • JavaScript
  • REST Countries

Project overview

I built this for a Frontend Mentor challenge. The interface fetches country data from REST Countries and presents flags, populations, regions and capitals in a searchable grid.

The original deployment remains available. Country results depend on the external API and may fail to load.
